Record Class RequestContext

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
forj.http.RequestContext
public record RequestContext(String requestId) extends Record
What every part of a request's handling may need to know about the request: its id, for logs and for the calls it makes downstream. The requestId middleware sets it; a handler makes it a local given and everything below asks for it with using, so nothing threads it by hand: 
GET(user).to((req, id) -> {
    given RequestContext context = RequestContext.of(req);
    return repo.find(id).map(u -> Ok(u));      // repo.find(id)(using RequestContext) gets it
})
